topics.title: Disk is full
steps: Run Storage overview and compare historical growth.
Preview safe cleanup; do not select Downloads automatically.
Review large files and developer caches.
Enable Storage Sense with explicit retention settings.
Move user-owned files to another verified volume.
warnings: Do not delete WinSxS, Installer, DriverStore, recovery partitions, or unknown ProgramData folders manually.

topics.title: Application will not uninstall
steps: Close related processes.
Try Repair first when available.
Use the native registered uninstaller or WinGet exact ID.
For MSI error 1618, wait for the existing Windows Installer transaction.
Use Microsoft's Program Install and Uninstall troubleshooter for corrupt registrations.
Review leftovers separately after native uninstall succeeds.
warnings: Never execute an uninstall string through cmd.exe string concatenation.

topics.title: Application will not start
steps: Check pending restart and available disk space.
Inspect recent application crash events.
Repair the package if supported.
Back up application settings before Reset.
Reinstall only after inventory and settings export.
warnings: Reset may remove sign-in state, offline content, and application settings.

topics.title: Windows Update problems
steps: Check pending restart and Windows Update service status.
Search with Windows Update Agent and inspect result codes.
Run DISM image health and SFC only when integrity symptoms exist.
Retry individual updates rather than a broad service reset.
Use update history and Code Integrity events to identify conflicts.
warnings: Do not permanently disable Windows Update services as an optimization.

topics.title: Slow startup
steps: Measure startup entries and scheduled logon tasks.
Disable one reversible third-party entry at a time.
Review boot and reliability events.
Check storage health and pending updates.
Compare before and after measurements.
warnings: Do not disable services based only on a generic debloat list.

topics.title: Network connectivity problems
steps: Verify adapter state, address, gateway, and DNS servers.
Test gateway then internet reachability then DNS resolution.
Inspect proxy and VPN configuration.
Flush DNS only for stale resolver symptoms.
Use Network Reset only after recording configuration.
warnings: Network Reset removes and reinstalls adapters and may remove VPN configuration.

topics.title: Microsoft Store problems
steps: Run WSReset.
Repair the Store app package.
Check time, region, network, and Windows Update.
Reset only after understanding sign-in and local data effects.
Re-register packages only as a targeted repair.
warnings: Broad re-registration scripts can produce noisy errors and should not be the first step.

topics.title: Boot and recovery problems
steps: Export the BCD store before any change.
Record Secure Boot, firmware mode, and WinRE status.
Use Windows Startup Repair and recovery media first.
Make one documented BCD change at a time only in Expert mode.
Retain a verified recovery path and another bootable device.
warnings: WinCare never replaces the Windows boot loader or writes raw EFI/NTFS structures.

topics.title: Security posture review
steps: Verify Defender, firewall, Secure Boot, TPM, and encryption status.
Update signatures and run a targeted scan.
Deploy WDAC policies in Audit Mode first.
Review Code Integrity events and allow legitimate software deliberately.
Promote to enforcement only after measured coverage and recovery testing.
warnings: Do not disable Defender, SmartScreen, UAC, or update services for performance claims.
